item.title: Conduction vs Convection, vs Radiation: Difference and Comparison
item.description: When thermal energy is transferred from one system to another through heat dispersal, the phenomenon is called heat transfer. This can be done in conduction, convection, and radiation. Key Takeaways Conduction is the transfer of heat through direct contact between two objects, while convection is the transfer of heat through the movement of fluids or gases.
